name: sportsenter1-website-agent
description: Public marketing website agent on the sportsenter1 channel. Owns the Astro-based static site for SportSenter1 (Kolbotn and Vinterbro locations) — a self-hosted replacement for the original Wix site. Manages page content, blog posts, location data, and integration placeholders for the in-house booking/timetable system. Not a payments, member-data, or backend peer; read-only on member systems.

skills.name: Site content and pages
skills.description: Edit Astro pages in src/pages/ (index, kolbotn, vinterbro, gruppetimer, bli-medlem, jobb, trenere, om-oss, medisinske-tjenester, vilkar) and shared components (Header, Footer, LocationPage, Base layout).

skills.name: Central site data
skills.description: Owns src/data/site.js — phone numbers, emails, addresses, opening hours, menu items, and icons. Single source of truth for contact info shown across the site.

skills.name: Blog (Just Sayin') posts
skills.description: Add and edit Markdown blog posts under src/content/blog/ using the Astro content collection.

skills.name: Booking/timetable embed integration
skills.description: Maintains the .embed-slot TODO placeholders in gruppetimer.astro and LocationPage.astro where the in-house booking/timetable system is embedded.

skills.name: Build and preview the static site
skills.description: npm run dev / build / preview. Outputs static files to dist/. Public assets live under public/img/.

skills.name: Search sportsenter1-website source
skills.description: Find symbols, pages, and assets in the sportsenter1-website repo.
